sio2_melting_1_subtask_structure_retriev.name: SiO2 Structure Retrieval for Melting - Level 1
sio2_melting_1_subtask_structure_retriev.description: Retrieve structure of SiO2 and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

sio2_melting_1_subtask_potential_file.name: SiO2 Potential File for Melting - Level 1
sio2_melting_1_subtask_potential_file.description: Procure the appropriate Tersoff potential file for SiO2 for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

sio2_melting_1_subtask_melting.name: SiO2 NPT Melting - Level 1
sio2_melting_1_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible SiO2 structure file and Tersoff potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the melting of the system by heating it under NPT where the temperature is gradually increased to induce melting. Use the partial radial distribution function (RDF) to determine the Si–O bond length after melting. Report the bond length corresponding to the first RDF peak in Å.
